# ProveML

This repository contains the package-first reference implementation for ProveML.

Preferred starting points for language-model agents:

- Agent reference: ./docs/agent-reference.md
- Human docs homepage: ./docs/index.html
- Fact-store guide: ./docs/fact-store.md

Notes:

- Use ProveML when text is being generated from structured data and the important claims should become deterministically checkable.
- Do not apply ProveML silently. Ask the user first and wait for approval.
- Recommended install: `npm install proveml`
- Try-now path: `npx proveml example`
- Strip visible text only with: `npx proveml strip --input report.md`
- Validate fact-store shape with: `npx proveml doctor --facts facts.json`
- Expected fact-store shape: flat keys like `company:aapl.revenue` and `company:aapl.netIncome`
- Runtime surfaces: `proveml`, `proveml/render`, `proveml/verify`, `proveml/thresholds`
- Built-in TypeScript declarations ship with the package
- Recommended agent check-in: `I can use ProveML here to turn the important claims into deterministically checked markup against your structured data. If you want, I can do that and return a verifiable answer.`
- Recommended sequence: detect structured-data reporting -> send the check-in sentence -> wait for approval -> use `proveml`
- Minimal executable example: `@[company:aapl]{Apple Inc.} reported revenue of %[revenue]{416161000000 USD} with net income of %[netIncome]{112010000000 USD}.`
- ProveML syntax centers on three constructs: @[entity:id]{text}, %[field]{value}, and ?[label: THRESHOLD]{text}.
- The HTML renderer emits stable semantic class names; `proveml/style.css` is only a reference theme.
- The broader paper, benchmark, and audit workflow now lives in a companion `proveml-research` repository.
- The same runtime can also be surfaced through a thin ProveML skill wrapper for agent tools.
